passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Kalanchoe variifolia (Guillaumin & Humbert) Shtein, D.-P.Klein & Gideon F.Sm..
The native range of this species is SE. Madagascar. It is a succulent subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
